name: Main Showroom
description: Grand central atrium featuring monumental glass facade, reflective marble floors, and flagship displays.
tour_caption: Welcome to Panda Motors Flagship Showroom. Featuring panoramic glass architecture overlooking the bay.

name: Hypercar Exhibition
description: Exclusive showcase dedicated to extreme power, radical aerodynamics, and V12 masterpieces.
tour_caption: The Hypercar Exhibition features cutting-edge aero carbon composites and record-breaking performance.

name: Supercar Gallery
description: Purebred track performers and high-revving sports icons beside the panoramic window.
tour_caption: The Supercar Gallery showcases legendary handling dynamics against the waterfront skyline backdrop.

name: Luxury Collection
description: Sumptuous executive sedans and flagship performance SUVs built for ultimate comfort and presence.
tour_caption: The Luxury Collection marries whisper-quiet bespoke craftsmanship with effortless power.

name: Electric Mobility Zone
description: Next-generation solid-state battery architecture and silent futuristic propulsion.
tour_caption: Electric Mobility Zone: pioneering the sustainable future with zero-emission hyper-efficiency.

name: Vehicle Configuration Studio
description: Studio lighting environment tailored for custom paint, wheel, and bespoke finish tailoring.
tour_caption: In our Configuration Studio, clients customize paint shades, textures, and bespoke details.

name: Customer Lounge
description: Private VIP mezzanine and designer lounge with designer sofas, refreshments, and brand video displays.
tour_caption: Relax in the designer VIP lounge surrounded by architectural landscaping and ambient hospitality.

name: Reception & Info Center
description: Front entry hospitality desk with concierge tablets, interactive brochures, and warm greeting wall.
tour_caption: Our reception team provides digital concierge services and personalized showroom itineraries.

name: Outdoor Display Area
description: Open-air lakeside terrace looking out across the sparkling water and mountain peaks.
tour_caption: Step outside to the lakeside terrace to enjoy natural daylight reflecting off the mountain bay.
